evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 is 5–7.5 ppm after the purge brought it down from 28766 ppm, so the tube is inert with no sign of a leak.
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint within 1 °C. It overshot to 760.5 °C at the start of growth, then settled at the 750 °C setpoint.
Heater power fell from 81% to 39–44% at the move to hold, as expected once the ramp ends. This agrees with the thermocouple.
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint.
Pressure is steady at about 3.0 Torr, consistent with 100 sccm flow, so there is no sign of an exhaust blockage.

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample exists yet (for example Raman or microscopy after the run). No reference [mean, sd] bands were given to check how large the 10.5 °C overshoot is compared with normal runs.
